files.summary: Screenshot of a competitor/reference website (IWILLBUILD portal) showing layout, navigation, and UI components. The user's prompt 'remove one' appears to reference removing a duplicate element (the two circled 'Launch Portal' buttons), suggesting this is a reference for design critique or inspiration rather than a file to display on their own site.
Screenshot of a domain management dashboard showing renewal and quick links options. User is asking for clarification on UI interaction, not requesting any site build changes.

Screenshot of a website interface showing a URL forwarding/connection feature with a light cyan background, icons, and input field. The user's prompt 'next' provides no clear directive for how this file should be used in the build.
Screenshot of a GoDaddy website builder dashboard showing a domain/website card for 'iwillbuild.com'. No explicit instruction provided on how to use this file.

Screenshot of the IWILLBUILD Portal website showing a published construction job portal with hero section, login interface, and feature overview. No explicit instruction provided on how to use this file.
Screenshot of a portal sign-in page showing the I WILL BUILD branding, login form, and error state. No explicit instruction provided on how to use this file.
Screenshot of an Estimating Library Cost Guide interface showing a table with cost items. Provided as a reference to illustrate the current state of the feature being modified by the specification.
Screenshot of the iWillBuild Jobs interface showing the Photos tab. Used as a reference for understanding the current UI layout and where to implement photo editing features.

Screenshot of a job management interface (JOB-001) showing client details, site address, and a PHOTOS section with Take Photo and Upload buttons. User is requesting a layout adjustment to move the photos section to the top.

Screenshot of a job management interface showing multiple photos (construction site, padlock, person) associated with JOB-001. The prompt 'now download function' is unclear and does not indicate how this file should be used on the site.

Screenshot of an image editing interface showing a padlock photo with markup tools. User is asking a technical question about the save button functionality, not requesting this image be used on their website.
Screenshot of a text input field with spelling check UI showing a testing scenario for builder box layout and text wrapping behavior.
Screenshot of a UI form showing a failed thumbnail upload with conditional logic controls. User is reporting a bug in the upload/thumbnail reduction workflow.

A technical specification document for fixing Job Form Runner scrolling behavior. Provides CSS guidance, layout rules, and validation steps for ensuring forms are scrollable across all devices and input methods.
Screenshot of a forms management interface showing two template cards (Pre-Start and Incident) with a dark theme. User is referencing this design to request a background color change to white.

Screenshot of a project management dashboard (iWillBuild) showing portal interface with navigation, job tracking, and fleet management sections. Provides visual reference for UI/UX design patterns and color scheme.
Screenshot of a form builder interface showing a dark-themed UI with a black backdrop and orange accent. User is referencing this to request a theme change for better visibility and consistency.

Screenshot of an existing dashboard UI (iwillbuild platform) showing a sidebar navigation with a collapse button highlighted. Provided as a reference to demonstrate UI interaction patterns and visual styling.
Screenshot of a Dazza AI Guardrails settings interface showing security features and a failed save error state. User appears to be referencing this as a troubleshooting or documentation example.
Screenshot of a Dazza AI Settings configuration panel showing an enable/disable toggle for the AI assistant feature.

Screenshot of a construction management chat interface showing a conversational AI assistant (Dazza) with navigation tabs and message history. The user's prompt provides no directive for how to use this file in a website build.

Screenshot of a settings interface showing privacy/compliance features and a failed save state. User's prompt suggests this is a troubleshooting reference rather than a design asset for the website build.
Screenshot of a dashboard/settings interface showing a notification badge (14) on a bell icon, used as a reference to identify and troubleshoot notification settings.
Screenshot of a UI showing a sidebar menu with a partially hidden button; user is requesting layout adjustment guidance rather than asking to display this image on their site.

Screenshot of a product pricing table in a sandbox environment showing three SaaS plans (Pro, Team, Solo) with pricing and categories. User is providing pricing update notes (GST exclusion, Team and Pro tier adjustments) for reference.
Screenshot of a user profile page showing account details for Daryl Williams with Admin status. User is reporting this as a testing/bug report issue, not requesting it be added to their website.
Screenshot of a dashboard interface showing a testing account issue where the owner profile remains visible after account creation, provided as a bug report reference.

Screenshot of a user profile page showing account details for Daryl Williams with an orange accent color and Save Profile button. User is reporting a testing issue where the old profile remains visible after creating a new trial account.

Screenshot of a dashboard sidebar menu showing current navigation structure (Dazza AI, Annette, Jobs, Fleet, Forms, Team, Billing, Settings, Log out). User is referencing this to request structural changes to the menu hierarchy.

Screenshot of an estimates management interface showing quote status workflow issues. User is referencing this to describe a bug or feature request about quote status tracking and permissions.
Screenshot of a project management interface showing an Estimates tab with draft quotes. User is referencing this to report a UI issue or clarify where a component has appeared.
Screenshot of a settings interface showing Job Statuses and Form Categories lists, provided as a reference to discuss UI/UX improvements (drag-and-drop or arrow ordering functionality).
